dryRun.description: Prints each change and makes none, as NX_DRY_RUN=true does

removeData.description: Also removes the data folders UXP hosts keep for this plug-in id, for a clean install

variables.description: Environment variables holding the base64 .p12 and its password that sign a CEP extension; unset, a self-signed certificate ZXPSignCmd creates once in the Nx workspace data folder signs it

title: Place
description: Places the unpacked plug-in the project's builds wrote into the host's per-user plug-in folder in one exchange, registers a UXP plug-in in its host's registry file, and signs a CEP extension before placing it
